# PolyAI

PolyAI builds enterprise dialog agents for complex customer conversations.

ProfilePrivate company

Founded[2017](https://aventure.vc/companies?yearFoundedRangeMin=2017&yearFoundedRangeMax=2017 "View all companies founded in 2017")

HQ[London, GB](https://aventure.vc/companies?headquartersCity=London&headquartersCountry=United+Kingdom "View all companies headquartered in London, GB") 🇬🇧United Kingdom

[website](https://poly.ai/)[discord](https://discord.gg/wvyMKEpjkX)[documentation](https://polyai.github.io/adk)[facebook](https://www.facebook.com/PolyAIVoice)[linkedin](https://www.linkedin.com/company/polyai)[twitter](https://x.com/polyaivoice)[wellfound](https://wellfound.com/company/polyai)[youtube](https://www.youtube.com/@polyaivoice)

PolyAI began with the insight that voice AI could handle complex dialog, not just simple requests.

The company builds enterprise dialog agents for complex customer conversations, working with enterprises, using Dialog Studio, a no-code builder for voice agents and conversational AI, and PolyAI Wren, an agentic loop for improving AI voice agents inside Dialog Studio.
